research_psychological_techniques.authority_impersonation: Uses claimed authority, office, institution, title, or identity to gain compliance.
research_psychological_techniques.phantom_riches: Promises an exaggerated, guaranteed, unexpected, or implausibly easy reward.
research_psychological_techniques.fear_intimidation: Threatens loss, punishment, arrest, account blocking, harm, or other serious consequences.
research_psychological_techniques.liking: Builds compliance through friendliness, similarity, compliments, sympathy, or rapport.
research_psychological_techniques.urgency_scarcity: Creates time pressure or claims an opportunity, deadline, or resource is limited.
research_psychological_techniques.pretext_trust: Constructs a plausible cover story or uses personal/contextual details to manufacture trust.
research_psychological_techniques.reciprocity: Provides or promises a favor, benefit, or help that creates pressure to reciprocate.
research_psychological_techniques.consistency_commitment: Uses a prior action or small commitment to pressure a larger consistent action.
research_psychological_techniques.social_proof: Uses claimed behavior, approval, or success of other people to normalize compliance.

digital_arrest_operational_signals.accusation: Claims that the target, identity, account, SIM, parcel, or relative is linked to a crime.
digital_arrest_operational_signals.secrecy_instruction: Directs the target not to tell family, bank staff, police, or other people.
digital_arrest_operational_signals.isolation_instruction: Attempts to move or keep the target alone or continuously connected to the scammer.
digital_arrest_operational_signals.surveillance_control: Demands screen sharing, video monitoring, continuous call presence, or environmental control.
digital_arrest_operational_signals.financial_demand: Requests or directs a transfer, deposit, payment, cash withdrawal, or asset movement.
digital_arrest_operational_signals.credential_request: Requests an OTP, PIN, password, CVV, login code, recovery code, or equivalent secret.
